items.name: Botswana Nationals 2026

venue.name: Botswana National Museum and Art Gallery

items.information:
First official WCA competition in Botswana.

The fastest competitor from Botswana in 3x3 event will be crowned national champion of Botswana.

Everyone can participate, but only people with Botswana nationality can win prizes and honours.

Three spots in the 3x3 final will be reserved for participants with Botswana nationality.

The competition is part of a tour around six countries in three weeks. That is why this competition will take place on a Wednesday afternoon and evening.

items.name: Wolfpack Wednesday NC IV 2026
items.information:
**This competition does NOT have the standard 3x3x3 Cube event and takes place on a Wednesday evening.**

**All competitors must read the [Competitor Information tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WolfpackWednesdayNCIV2026#76296-competitor-information) prior to registering.** Please read all tabs prior to the competition and regularly check your email for updates from us. All contact will be made by email.

This competition is supported by [Southeast Cubing, Inc.](https://southeastcubing.org/about), the official nonprofit organization for speedcubing in the Southeast! Please check out the [Southeast Cubing, Inc. tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WolfpackWednesdayNCIV2026#76302-southeast-cubing-inc) to learn more about the organization and what you can do to support the mission.
